scenarios.input: Где мы считали бюджет по категориям и норму сбережений?

reports: one line of the matched snippet
must_not: answer from memory without running the search
invent a session id that is not in the command output

scenarios.input: Find the session where we picked a hotel with free cancellation

expect.notes: the index is bilingual, so an English query finds Russian notes

scenarios.input: Найди, где мы обсуждали настройку квантового телепорта

suggests: a technical term instead of a description

must_not: copy the author's index or dictionary
write any personal data into the repository

expect.explains: the index is at most 5 minutes old before a search, the updater runs hourly

scenarios.input: Найди, где мы обсуждали, что денег в этом месяце в обрез

expect.runs: oc-recall "денег в этом месяце в обрез"
expect.reports: either a session about the budget, if the optional embedding mode is on, or an honest no-result
must_not: claim semantic understanding when the embedding mode is off

scenarios.input: Включи, чтобы поиск находил и без общих слов

reports: which model was chosen and how it was obtained
must_not: ask the user to set environment variables by hand
claim that paraphrases without shared words are now solved
